purpose: Failure taxonomy for real tender queries that remain unresolved after the first-pass and catalog-wide deep review.

semantics.CATALOG_NO_MATCH: No credible catalog match was evidenced after the catalog-wide deep pass. This does not prove mathematical absence from the source CSV; do not treat it as a retrieval regression until a valid catalog item is identified.
semantics.ALIAS_MAPPING_MISS: The tender uses a legacy/vendor/designation vocabulary that is not explicitly mapped to the LD naming system. A valid analog may exist, but equivalence is not evidenced strongly enough for GOLD.
semantics.PARSER_MISS: The query contains a value or notation whose meaning is parsed incorrectly or ambiguously before matching.
semantics.QUERY_UNDERSPECIFIED: The tender line does not contain enough constraints to define a useful item-level target.
semantics.SCHEMA_GAP: A requirement understood by a human is not represented by the current deterministic requirement schema, so a candidate cannot be safely verified.
semantics.RETRIEVAL_MISS: A known-valid catalog item exists but the retrieval stage fails to surface it. This reason requires positive catalog evidence and is intentionally not assigned merely because search returned poor candidates.

summary.key_observation: None of the 24 cases is currently proven to be a pure RETRIEVAL_MISS. The dominant unresolved group is no-evidenced-catalog-match, followed by designation/alias mapping gaps.

recommended_priority.reason: Seven unresolved lines use recognizable legacy/designation vocabulary. Build an explicit equivalence layer before changing embeddings or fusion weights.
Twelve lines have no evidenced valid LD item after catalog-wide review. Separate unsupported/out-of-catalog behavior from retrieval quality.
Four lines are blocked by requirements or notation that the current normalized schema cannot safely express.
Only optimize retrieval on cases where a human-verified catalog target is known. Otherwise retrieval tuning risks optimizing toward false matches.

queries.query: Задвижка фланцевая 30с41нж ДУ150 РУ16
queries.evidence: The query is driven by designation 30с41нж. Catalog-wide review did not produce a candidate whose equivalence to that designation could be established confidently.
queries.recommended_fix: Add designation/analog mapping for 30с41нж to LD gate-valve families only after subject-matter validation; until then keep unresolved rather than accepting a merely similar DN/PN valve.

queries.query: Задвижка фланцевая 30с41нж ДУ50 РУ16
queries.evidence: Same 30с41нж designation problem as q001 at DN50; no validated LD-equivalent was evidenced in the deep pass.
queries.recommended_fix: Resolve the 30с41нж designation family once, then apply DN/PN constraints deterministically.

queries.query: Задвижка фланцевая 30с41нж ДУ100 РУ16
queries.evidence: Same 30с41нж designation problem at DN100; no validated LD-equivalent was evidenced in the deep pass.
queries.recommended_fix: Use a validated designation equivalence table before retrieval ranking.

queries.query: Фланец воротниковый приварной в стык Ду 65 мм, ст. 09Г2С, Py 1,6 МПа
queries.evidence: DN, PN and steel grade are representable, but the required weld-neck/butt-weld flange subtype is not safely represented by the current deterministic schema. Similar flanges cannot be promoted to GOLD on DN/PN/material alone.
queries.recommended_fix: Add flange_subtype/weld-neck semantics and normalize GOST flange type before deciding whether this is truly absent from the catalog.

queries.query: Фланец воротниковый приварной в стык Ду 50 мм, ст. 09Г2С, Py 1,6 МПа
queries.evidence: The decisive requirement is the weld-neck/butt-weld flange subtype, which current normalized fields do not prove reliably.
queries.recommended_fix: Represent flange subtype explicitly, then rerun catalog verification.

queries.query: Фланец воротниковый приварной встык Ду 80
queries.evidence: DN is simple, but the defining weld-neck/butt-weld subtype is outside the current strict schema.
queries.recommended_fix: Add flange_subtype and only then classify candidates as valid/invalid.

queries.query: Кран стальной шаровой муфтовый 11с39п Ду 25 Ру25, рабочая температура -30+200С
queries.evidence: LD has threaded steel ball-valve families, but the catalog-wide review did not establish that any candidate is an equivalent of designation 11с39п. The requested temperature range is also not part of the current hard constraint schema.
queries.recommended_fix: Validate 11с39п-to-LD equivalence and add temperature_min/temperature_max constraints.

queries.query: Кран стальной шаровой муфтовый 11с39п Ду 20 Ру25, рабочая температура -30+200С
queries.evidence: Same unresolved 11с39п equivalence as q014, now at DN20; temperature compatibility is also unevidenced.
queries.recommended_fix: Resolve designation equivalence once and verify temperature range before creating positive IDs.

queries.query: Кран стальной шаровой муфтовый 11с39п Ду 50 Ру25, рабочая температура -30+200С
queries.evidence: Same 11с39п alias/equivalence gap at DN50; matching only steel/threaded/DN/PN would be insufficient.
queries.recommended_fix: Create a subject-validated alias mapping plus temperature constraints.

queries.query: Кран шаровой ПНД компрессионный Ду32Ру16, наружный (в колодце), компрессионный-обжимной
queries.evidence: After compact DN/PN parsing was fixed, the catalog-wide pass still did not surface a credible PND compression/collet ball valve. Ordinary brass/threaded valves are not acceptable substitutes.
queries.recommended_fix: Treat as unsupported/no-evidenced-match unless a PND compression product is identified; model connection technology explicitly if such products are added.

queries.query: Задвижка клиновая фланцевая с выдвижным шпинделем d 108мм, Ру 16 МПа
queries.evidence: The query specifies d=108 mm rather than an explicit DN. Treating 108 as DN would be unsafe; it may describe pipe outside diameter and requires domain-aware normalization. The spindle construction is also a structured requirement.
queries.recommended_fix: Distinguish pipe OD from DN; add explicit OD-to-DN normalization only where a standard mapping is justified, and represent rising-stem construction.

queries.query: Кран стальной шаровой муфтовый 11с39п Ду 32 Ру25 рабочая температура -30+200С
queries.evidence: Same 11с39п designation family as q014-q016, with no validated LD equivalence and an unevaluated temperature range.
queries.recommended_fix: Validate designation mapping and temperature compatibility before turning this into a hard-gate positive.

queries.query: Кран шаровый фланцевый КШ.Ф.050.080-02 с ручным управлением с комплектом ответных фланцев, Ду 50, Ру 8 МПа
queries.evidence: The deep pool contained DN50 flanged ball valves with flange kits, but observed candidates had lower pressure ratings than the requested 8 MPa. Exact designation equivalence was also not evidenced.
queries.recommended_fix: Do not relax PN. Mark unsupported unless a PN>=8 MPa item is identified; separately model kit contents and designation aliases.

queries.query: дисковый затвор Ду80
queries.evidence: This is a very simple product_type+DN query. The catalog-wide pass did not produce a credible butterfly valve DN80, making catalog coverage a stronger hypothesis than text retrieval failure.
queries.recommended_fix: Verify catalog coverage for butterfly DN80; only create a RETRIEVAL_MISS after identifying a valid LD target.

queries.query: дисковый затвор Ду40
queries.evidence: Simple product_type+DN query, but no credible DN40 butterfly-valve item was evidenced in catalog-wide review.

queries.query: дисковый затвор Ду50

queries.query: дисковый затвор Ду32 - 3шт.

queries.query: Задвижки стальные
queries.evidence: Product family and material are given, but DN, PN and other selection constraints are absent; many different catalog items could satisfy the text.
queries.recommended_fix: Treat as NEED_CLARIFICATION/diagnostic rather than force an item-level GOLD match.

queries.query: Клапан запорный, стальной, проходной, фланцевый, 15с27нж (15с52нж9), номинальное давление PN 6,3 МПа, номинальный диаметр DN 15 мм
queries.evidence: The line is highly specified, yet catalog-wide review produced no confidently equivalent stop-valve target for the requested designation/DN/PN. A merely similar valve must not count.
queries.recommended_fix: Audit whether this stop-valve family exists in LD; if an LD analog exists, encode explicit 15с27нж/15с52нж9 equivalence.

queries.query: Клапан запорный, стальной, проходной, фланцевый, 15с27нж (15с52нж9), номинальное давление PN 6,3 МПа, номинальный диаметр DN 25 мм
queries.evidence: Same well-specified stop-valve family as q041 at DN25, with no evidenced equivalent target after catalog-wide review.
queries.recommended_fix: Verify catalog family coverage first; add designation aliases only if a subject-validated analog exists.
